dialogue.speaker: Damir
dialogue.text: Kamila, is this your building? It looks really nice!

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: Yes! Come in — welcome to our apartment! There is a coat hook on the left.

dialogue.speaker: Damir
dialogue.text: Thanks! How many rooms are there?

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: There are three rooms: a living room, a kitchen, and a bedroom.

dialogue.speaker: Damir
dialogue.text: Is there a separate study room? You always study so much!

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: No, there isn't. But there is a desk in the bedroom for each of us.

dialogue.speaker: Damir
dialogue.text: Oh nice! Is there a TV in the living room?

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: Yes, there is a TV on the wall. And there are two big bookshelves.

dialogue.speaker: Damir
dialogue.text: Are there any plants? Zara mentioned she loves plants.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: Ha! There are four plants on the balcony and one in the bedroom.

dialogue.speaker: Damir
dialogue.text: Is there a balcony? Can I see it?

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: Of course! There is a great view of the courtyard. Come look!

dialogue.speaker: Damir
dialogue.text: Wow — there are so many trees down there! Is there a park nearby?

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: Yes, there is a small park just around the corner. Very peaceful.

dialogue.speaker: Damir
dialogue.text: This is amazing. Is there anything you don't like about this apartment?

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: Honestly? There is no dishwasher! That's the only problem!

task1Items.question: There are three rooms in Kamila's apartment.
There is a separate study room in the apartment.
There is a TV and two bookshelves in the living room.
There are five plants on the balcony.
There is a small park near the apartment building.
Kamila says there is no washing machine in the apartment.

listenStatements.text: Shows the apartment and welcomes the guest inside.
Asks if there is a separate study room.
Says there is a desk in the bedroom for each person.
Points out there is a great view of the courtyard from the balcony.
Says the only problem is there is no dishwasher.
